messages.text: All the clocks chime at once! (+1 point)

interactions.label: Throw the bone for the cat

messages.text: The cat brings it back! (+1 point)

interactions.label: Show the amulet to the vampire
messages: The vampire hisses and runs away, dropping a bag of coins. (+5 points)

1_0.name: Hallway
1_0.description: An almost empty hallway. Until you see in the corner a long bone, perhaps a human's femur???

0_1.name: The ominous room
0_1.description: A dark room, but only one singular light is shining down on a table with a cup of coffee and a key. You drink the coffee and grab the key

2_0.name: Main Hall
2_0.description: The main area of the house and a totally not suspicious vampire looking at you

0_2.name: Kitchen
0_2.description: A nice modern-looking kitchen. Nothing special in here.

3_0.name: Clock room
3_0.description: A room just filled with a lot of clocks. But one stands out to you, and you turn it around and find a key!

1_3.name: A zoo?
1_3.description: You enter the room that says free food on it, only to step into a room full of giraffes. You pick one giraffe, and suddenly it gagged out a hammer. Free hammer, I guess.

2_3.name: Suspicious room
2_3.description: A hooded man is standing in the middle of the room. You approach him, and he asks if you got the stuff. You're unsure what stuff he's talking about, and he suddenly points at the giraffe. You give it to him in exchange for pie.

3_3.name: Treasure room
3_3.description: You have made it to your destination! Let's count how many treasures you were able to collect on your way here.
